description:
Create multiple text-based highlights in one batch (max 10 per request).

Efficient for chapter analysis — create highlights in batches of up to 10.
If you have more than 10, split into multiple calls.

Highlight format: {page_number: int, text: str, comment?: str, color?: str}
Colors: amber (#E5A84B) core ideas, sage (#6BBF8A) action items, sky (#5BA3D9) questions.

params.description: Parameters for creating multiple text-based highlights at once.

highlights.description: Array of highlights. Each: {page_number: int, text: str, comment?: str, color?: str}
